verified: edh-combat-6 (Commander lane edh-combat), by hand against the Oracle text, the rules and the rulings (trg.when, eff.edhcb6.draw.player.ifCond, the player-attacks hole): CR 508.1, 506.3, 603.2c, 608.2c; rulings 2023-04-14: the draw looks at all the attackers of the declaration and needs none of them to have attacked you (a planeswalker or battle does not count as you), and it does not matter what happens to the creatures once it triggers (the history of the combat)

edh-combat-6 (Commander lane edh-combat), by hand against the Oracle text and the rules (trg.when, eff.counters.player, the batch-damage 'that opponent' mention and the players-being-attacked condition): CR 510.2, 603.2c, 603.4, 122.1f, 506.2, 506.3, 508.1; ruling 2023-02-04: a player is poisoned if they have one or more poison counters; every attacker of a combat is controlled by the active player, so the creatures that dealt the damage have one controller, 'that opponent'

edh-combat-6 (Commander lane edh-combat), by hand against the Oracle text and the rules (sta.edhcb6.attack.noDefender.attackedYouLastTurn, kw.line; 6.9 deviation: one card prints the wording): CR 609.4, 702.3b, 508.1b, 506.3, 500.1: only a player (never a planeswalker or battle) who was the defending player of an attack on the controller during the most recent turn that player was the active player before this one

edh-combat-6 (Commander lane edh-combat), by hand against the Oracle text, the rules and the rulings (trg.when with the fight action and 'become blocked', the beginning-of-combat ability was already read): CR 701.14a, 509.3c, 603.2c; rulings 2020-06-23: dealing combat damage isn't fighting; one card however many creatures fought or became blocked; a 'fight' is reported for each creature of each fight

edh-combat-6 (Commander lane edh-combat), by hand against the Oracle text and the rules (eff.edhcb6.whenever.thatCreature.combatDamage.thisCombat, eff.cont.grant, layouts becomes prepared; 6.9 deviation: one card prints the wording): CR 603.7, 603.7c, 510.2, 511.3, 722.3a: the delayed trigger waits for combat damage by the target creature to a player until the end of this combat only

edh-combat-6 (Commander lane edh-combat), by hand against the Oracle text, the rules and the rulings (sta.edhcb6.attack.onlyAlone, eff.edhcb6.obj.assignsNoCombatDamage, kw.line, attacksUnblocked with the defending player, eff.setlife; 6.9 deviation: one card prints each wording): CR 506.5, 508.1c, 509.1h, 508.5, 510.1, 119.5; rulings 2013-04-15: it may attack, but only alone (a requirement on another creature takes precedence); it triggers in the declare blockers step when unblocked; the life total becomes 1 by losing (or gaining) the difference; assigning no combat damage is not prevention. Ruling 2024-01-12: attacking a planeswalker or battle does not trigger it
